# Knuckles-Team organization front door: how to find the project map and contribute.
Front door: https://knuckles-team.github.io/.github/
Architecture explorer: https://knuckles-team.github.io/.github/architecture/
Contribution guide: https://github.com/Knuckles-Team/.github/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
Skills: https://github.com/Knuckles-Team/universal-skills/tree/main/universal_skills/skills
Spec details JSON: https://knuckles-team.github.io/.github/architecture/spec-details/<repo>/<family>.json

Projects and roles:
- Medulla (formerly epistemic-graph): the knowledge engine. One engine, one server executable (medulla-server), package medulla. No synced second database; external stores are connector sources read as virtual graphs.
- Arbora (formerly graph-os): the one door. Served operations, admission, authentication, MCP and A2A serving, registry.
- Meristem (formerly agent-utilities): the in-run harness. It applies decisions it receives and holds no store.
- Scion SDK (formerly agent-connector-sdk): connector contracts and transports.
- Overstory (browser), Tuig (terminal), Axil (desktop): operator surfaces that reach data through Arbora.
- Spec ID prefixes: MEDULLA-, ARBORA-, MERISTEM-, SCION-, OVERSTORY-, TUIG-, AXIL-, CONN-<REPO>-, PIPE-.
- Rust serde types are the source of truth. No generated API contracts are committed. Spec status is computed at read time.
- The ecosystem is developed inside Medulla as changesets, a code graph, and requirement records, served through Arbora MCP.

How to contribute:
1. Start at the front door, https://knuckles-team.github.io/.github/.
2. Read the contribution guide, https://github.com/Knuckles-Team/.github/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md.
3. Pick an open (SPECIFIED) row here. Expand it to read its requirement and design, and open its specs/<family>/ folder.
4. Set up with the arbora-development skill from universal-skills, https://github.com/Knuckles-Team/universal-skills/tree/main/universal_skills/skills/arbora-development.
5. Build it, run the repo's gates, and open a PR whose commit carries a Spec: trailer with the row ID.
